A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you come.

What time are you open?+

We are open from 12 noon to 11 pm. The dhaba is closed on the last Monday of every month. Please call for any special-day changes.

Where is the original Kesar Da Dhaba?+

Chowk Passian, Gali Rajpura, near Telephone Exchange, Amritsar, Punjab. Follow our Google Maps link to the original location.

Do you have other branches?+

No. Kesar Da Dhaba has no other branches. Please visit the original restaurant in Amritsar.

Can I ask about a group visit?+

Yes. Please call 0183 253 2227 to discuss your visit directly with the team.

Can I take something home?+

Our shop lists traditional Punjabi Achaar and Mukhwas. Explore the shop and contact the team on WhatsApp for availability and ordering.
